app.name: InvoiceFlow
app.tagline: Invoices into spreadsheets, clean and under control

meta.homeDescription: Upload PDF, XML and image invoices; extract, review and export CSV/XLSX for business accounting.
meta.workspaceDescription: Batch upload PDF, XML, JPG and PNG invoices for data extraction.
meta.editorDescription: Review, correct and arrange invoice data before export.

landing.headline: From a stack of invoices to a clean spreadsheet, in one session
landing.subhead: Upload XML e-invoices, PDFs or photos. Review the cells that need attention, fix in batches and export CSV/XLSX.
landing.step1Body: Drag and drop many invoices at once.
landing.step2Body: Read XML, PDF text and recognise characters right in the browser.
landing.step3Body: Prioritise cells that need checking and see exactly where they sit on the original.
landing.step4Body: Download CSV or XLSX using your column template.
landing.privacyBody: In default mode, invoice content is processed in browser memory. We only store account preferences and export templates when you sign in and choose to save. We will publish network audit results before making any privacy guarantees.
landing.faq1A: No. You can upload, review and export without signing in. Google sign-in is only used to save export templates.
landing.faq2Q: Are my invoices uploaded to a server?
landing.faq2A: In default mode, files are processed locally in the browser. Export templates only contain column settings, never invoice content.
landing.faq3Q: How many invoices can I upload at once?
landing.faq3A: During beta, up to {{count}} files per batch.
landing.faq4A: The first version exports one row per invoice. Line items are not supported yet.
